title: pedicularis verticillata subsp. latisecta
intro: Pedicularis verticillata subsp. latisecta, commonly known as Lateral-leafed Lousewort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lateral-leafed Lousewort include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain, and support respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its use in traditional remedies for various health conditions.
